title: Sunflowers of Reed--Solomon Codes
summary: We introduce and study Reed--Solomon sunflowers, namely families of Reed--Solomon codes whose pairwise intersections are all equal to the same fixed subspace. This notion lies at the intersection of extremal subspace combinatorics and coding theory: it can be viewed as a structured version of the sunflower problem in the Grassmannian, and it naturally produces constant-dimension subspace codes with prescribed minimum distance.
